purpose: The one placeholder layout, top-aligned and centred across, with optional icon, title, description, and buttons, for any page, tab, section, or panel that has no data to render.
useWhen: Communicating that a list, table, or workspace has no items yet and suggesting a next step.
Replacing a primary content region after a filter or search returns no results.
Confirming all work is finished (done kind), or that a filter hid every item (filtered kind).
Saying a thing doesn't exist (not-found kind), or that a recoverable condition blocks the view (blocked kind).
Saying that a setting the person chose, such as a disabled plugin, holds content back with the disabled kind.

avoidWhen.reason: Indicating that data is still loading — use skeleton or spinner instead.
Reporting a transient error — use alert, banner, or toast-region.
